page.layout: One printed page: title page, all lines centred in one column. No margin notes. The digitiser's watermark at lower right is excluded.

main_text.l: Qua defenditur censura vulgatæ versionis ad VI.
priora capita Geneseos, ab ipso oppugnata

page.notes: The first line is in italic capitals with an unusual A-like letter in "AMAMA"; the name "SIXTINI AMAMA" is read as printed. The name "MARSENNI" ends with a superscript mark, rendered here without it. The top-left mark and scattered specks are stains, not text.
